criteriaNotes.1_topdown_flat: Blob edges and corners read as flat ground. All thin shapes (isolated cell, dead ends, 1-wide bands, bends, T, cross: every cell with a narrow centred border exit) render as strings of diamond/leaf-shaped bush lobes or arrowhead sprouts - object-like (shrubs/clover) rather than ground.
criteriaNotes.2_seams: No hard seams or colour breaks. Border dark runs differ by 1px between piece types (4-10 vs 3-11, 8-15 vs 9-15) causing small steps; arm cells pinch to 7px necks at every border so 1-wide regions look discontinuous/beaded. Stray detached pixels: (8,12)/(9,13) in 672/718, (9,1) in 686/688/691/694/696 and woodland counterparts. 1px border holes in 677/693/694/695 match the original interior texture.
criteriaNotes.3_colour: The 4 woodland colours (#759951 #688c48 #81a359 #8aab60) are a consistent desaturation of 737's 4 tones, sit naturally beside the original dark grass and crowns; no muddy/off-palette look.
criteriaNotes.4_style: Dark side copies the original 11628 dither and highlight language; light side copies 737/650. No smeared or generated noise.
criteriaNotes.5_maps: Straight edges show an obvious 16px sawtooth: each straight-edge tile carries one big lobe, so stacked/rowed edges (r9-route-1 721 column, s4/s1 slab boundaries, field blob sides) repeat visibly; combined with grid-aligned map layouts this reads as serrated square slabs. Corners and inner corners are fine under the original crowns.

cells.reasons: Woodland base: pixel-identical layout to original 737 with 4 desaturated colours; reads as flat ground, sits fine beside original crowns in s1-s8. Note: inherits 737's 16px glyph wallpaper repetition (original trait, not introduced here).
Isolated single cell is a round dark leafy tuft with highlight dots and scalloped rim; in field-plain it reads as a small bush/shrub object rather than a patch of ground (crit 1).

Thin 1-cell-wide arm(s) (border exit only 7-9px, centred). Each arm cell is a single centred diamond/leaf lobe pinched at both borders, so 1-wide bands, dead ends, bends, T and cross junctions render as a chain of bush/clover/arrowhead shapes (seams-plain, field spurs) - reads as plants standing on grass, not flat ground (crit 1), and the beads repeat every 16px (crit 5). Arm borders also step by 1px between 4-10 and 3-11 runs.
